planting.note: Plant rooted cuttings or container stock in spring in well-drained potting mix in bright indirect light to partial shade; Neon holds its solid chartreuse color best in brighter light and tends to green up in deep shade.

directions: Plant in well-drained, humus-rich potting mix in bright, indirect light to partial shade, protected from direct hot sun which can scorch the leaves. Neon is a pothos cultivar prized for its uniform, glowing chartreuse-yellow-green foliage, a solid, unmarbled color rather than the variegated patterns typical of most pothos, giving it a bright, almost glowing presence that stands out in a shelf or hanging basket display. It trails or climbs readily on a moss pole or totem and tolerates average indoor conditions and irregular watering better than most houseplants, though its signature color fades toward plain green in low light, so a brighter spot keeps it looking its best. In zone 9a it can summer outdoors in a shaded spot but must come indoors well before frost, since it has no cold tolerance.
